article.title: Israel merges two settler outposts near Jerusalem, furthering the fragmentation of the West Bank
article.author: Qassam Muaddi
article.content: Announced days after UK and European sanctions on settlements, Israel’s expansion of Mishmar Yehuda folds an illegal outpost into a planned city between Jerusalem and Bethlehem, advancing Israel’s decades-old plan to cut the West Bank in half.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
